verses.text: Ha heb' soldado ayoch yet' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', najtil ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' ayoch yet' winhaj David, palta jab'jab'il ix el yip heb', haxo pax heb' yik winhaj David chi' ix te tek'k'aj heb'.

Ha heb' yuninal winhaj David ix alji t'a Hebrón, haton sb'i heb' tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Amnón yune' ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel, winhaj Quileab, yune' ix Abigail, ix yetb'eyumkan winhaj xilb'a Nabal, aj Carmel, winhaj Absalón yune' ix Maaca yisil winhaj Talmai sreyal Gesur, winhaj Adonías yune' ix Haguit, winhaj Sefatías yune' ix Abital yet' winhaj Itream yune' ix Egla. Haton sb'i heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj David tik yet' heb' yuninal ix alji ayik ayek' winh t'a Hebrón.
Ayik aynhej och owal t'a skal heb' yik winhaj David yet' heb' ayoch yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Saúl, haxo winhaj Abner chi' ix ste ik'ej yipok winh t'a skal heb' yik winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ha winhaj Saúl chi', aykan jun ix yetb'eyum winh skuchan Rizpa, yisil winhaj Aja. Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Is-boset t'a winhaj Abner chi': --¿Tas yuj ix ach way yet' ix yetb'eyumkan winh in mam? xchi winh t'a winh.

Yujto ix yal jun chi' winhaj Is-boset chi' t'a winhaj Abner chi', yuj chi' ix te kot yowal winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tom tz'i' in tzila', tokwal wan wak'anoch in b'a yet' heb' ajk'ol yik Judá tik? Ha in tik, te wach'nhej ix wutej in b'a t'a heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh a mam yet' t'a heb' wach' yak'an yet' winh, maj ach wak'paxoch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj David, haxo tiknaik tzak'an yowalil t'ayin yuj jun ix ix chi'.

Ha Jehová ix yak' sti' t'a winhaj David to tz'ik'jiek' opisio t'a winhaj Saúl yet' pax t'a heb' yinhtilal, tz'ochkan winhaj David chi' reyal t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá, skotnhej t'a chonhab' Dan masanto t'a Beerseba. Kotokab' yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a wib'anh tato max wak' wip yelk'och tas ix yal chi', xchi winh.
Majxo yal-laj yalan junok b'elanh lolonel winhaj Is-boset t'a winhaj Abner chi', yujto xiwnak winh t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at juntzanh schekab' winhaj Abner chi' yal t'a winhaj David icha tik: ¿Tom manhok in ay wopisio t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik? Ha tiknaik ko b'o junok ko trato yik tzin och het'ok, yik wach' masanil heb' ketchonhab' tz'och heb' het'ok, xchib'at winh.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi': Syal in b'oan in trato chi' het'ok, palta ay jun tas yowalil tzojtakejeli: Max yal-laj a jawi t'a wichanh tato manh et'nakok ix wetb'eyum, ix Mical yisilkan winhaj xilb'a Saúl, xchib'at winh.

Ix schekanpaxb'at heb' schekab' winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Is-boset, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ak'kot ix Mical, ix wetb'eyum, haton ix wik'nak yik wak'annak jun ciento sjolom swinakil heb' winh filisteo yuj stojolok ix t'a winh smam, xchib'at winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Is-boset chi' to tz'ik'jiek' ix t'a winh yetb'eyum, haton winhaj Paltiel, yuninal winhaj Lais.
Ha winhaj Paltiel chi', ix b'at tzak'an winh yuj ix, ix och ijan winh yok'i, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Bahurim. Hata' ix yal winhaj Abner chi' t'a winh to smeltzaj winh, yuj chi' ix meltzajkan winh.
Yakb'an chi', ix laj lolon winhaj Abner yet' heb' yichamtak winakil Israel, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ayxo stiempoal ix he na' a ex tik to a winhaj David tz'och he reyalok.

Ha tiknaik jun, toxo ix k'och stiempoal yik tz'och winh, yujto yalnakkan Jehová yuj winh schekab' chi', to a winh ol kolan schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol sk'ab' masanil juntzanh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh, xchi winh.

Ix lolonpax winh yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab' aj Benjamín, ix lajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a Hebrón yik slolon winh yet' winhaj David yuj tas ix yal heb' yetisraelal heb' yet' tas ix yal masanil heb' yetchonhab' heb' aj Benjamín chi'.
Ix k'och winh yet' 20 heb' soldado t'a Hebrón b'aj ayek' winhaj David chi'. Ix schekan b'ojok jun niwan wael winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Abner yet' pax yuj heb' ajun yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Abner chi' t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik mamin rey, yowalil tzin b'at in molb'ej masanil heb' ketisraelal, yik sb'oan junok trato heb' het'ok, icha wal chi' ol aj ak'an reyal icha wal tas tza nib'ej, xchi winh. --Ixik an, xchi winhaj David chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankan kilkob'a winhaj Abner chi', ix b'at winh t'a tzalajk'olal.

Hato wal sb'at winhaj Abner chi', ix k'och winhaj Joab yet' heb' soldado winhaj David, spetoj heb' t'a owal. Te tzijtum tastak yet'nak heb', haton tas ix laj yik'ek' heb' t'a heb' yajk'ool. Ayik ix k'och winhaj Joab yet' masanil heb' soldado ajun yet'ok, ix alji t'a winh to a winhaj Abner chi', ix ulek' winh lolonel yet' winh rey chi', toxo ix meltzaj winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, ¿tas yuj icha chi' ix a k'ulej? Yujto a winhaj Abner ix ulek' t'ayach, ix a chaanxib'at winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Mamin rey ¿tom manh ojtakok to a winhaj Abner chi' tonhej tzul smusej a sat winh yik syil winh tas tza k'ulej yet' tas aji? xchi winh.

Ixnhej lajwi slolon winh yet' winh rey chi', ix schekan winh b'at saychaj winhaj Abner chi' t'a elk'altak, hato b'aj ay ha' uk'b'ila' yik Sira, hata' ix meltzaj winh yuj heb', palta manh yojtakoklaj winhaj David chi' tas yaji.

Ayik ix jax winhaj Abner chi' t'a Hebrón, haxo winhaj Joab chi' ix chaan winh sjawi t'a spatikel chonhab' chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winh t'a stz'eyb'at sti' jun chonhab' chi', yik slolon heb' winh ta' sch'okoj. Hata' ix stipoch yespada winhaj Joab chi' t'a sk'ol winh, ix cham winh, yik syak'anek' spak winh yuk'tak winhaj Joab chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj David, ix yalan winh: Syil Jehová to a in tik yet' masanil heb' in chekab' malaj kalan kik t'a schamel winhaj Abner chi'.

Kotokab'kan jun tik t'a yib'anh winhaj Joab yet' t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winh yet' heb' sk'ab' yok. Ha t'a skal heb', ayokab' mach ol yab' syail yuj tas tz'el t'a sniwanil, ayokab' mach ol penaayax yuj lepra, ayokab'pax mach tz'em sb'eyi, ayokab' mach smiljichamok yet' mach scham yuj wejel, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Joab chi' yet' winhaj Abisai ix milancham winhaj Abner chi', yujto ayik ix och owal t'a Gabaón, a winhaj Abner chi' ix milancham winhaj Asael, winh yuk'tak heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey t'a winhaj Joab chi' yet' t'a masanil heb' ajun yet' winh to snhik'chitejel spichul heb', yik tz'och heb' t'a kusk'olal yuj schamel winhaj Abner chi'. Ix och tzak'an winh rey chi' t'a spatik mach ix b'akhanb'at sniwanil winh chi'.
Ha t'a Hebrón ix smuk sniwanil winh chi' heb'. Ix ok' winh rey chi' b'aj ix mukchaj winhaj Abner chi', ix ok'pax masanil heb' anima ajun yet' winh.
Yuj chi' ix sb'itej jun b'it yik kusk'olal winh rey chi': Ach Abner ¿tas yuj icha chi' ix aj a chami? Icha tz'aj scham heb' sk'ulan chukal ix aj a chami.

Tokwal tzek'b'il a k'ab', ma tzek'b'il ok t'a k'een cadena. Icha wal tz'aj scham junok mach t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima te chuk sb'eyb'al, icha chi' ix aj a chami, xchi winhaj David chi'. Haxo heb' anima chi', ix ok'pax heb' yuj schamel winhaj Abner chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj David chi' to swa jab'ok winh yakb'an manto em k'u, palta ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Dios: --Aokab' Dios tz'ak'anoch yaelal t'a wib'anh tato swab'lej jab'ok wael ma junokxo tasi ayik manto em k'u, xchi winh.
Masanil anima ayek' ta', ix nachajel jun chi' yuj heb', ix scha wal sk'ol heb', yujto masanil tas sk'ulej winhaj David chi' scha sk'ol heb' anima smasanil.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' israel chi' smasanil to a winhaj rey David chi', manh lokanoklaj winh t'a schamel winhaj Abner chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a masanil heb' schekab': --Ojtakejekeli to a tiknaik ix cham jun winh sat yajal t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik.
Yuj chi' wach'chom ha Dios ix in sik'anoch reyal, palta ste el wip swab' yuj schuk spensaril heb' winh yune' ix Sarvia. Aokab' Jehová ol ak'an spak t'a jun mach ix k'ulan chukal tik, xchi winh.
